findings_summary: All three publications are genuine P022 replay evidence, but they are not semantic duplicates. TP2-DE338F269CA11E9BC01B isolates the q=3r-1 primitive Franel arithmetic core; TP2-D78DBA0243911E0363FA isolates the forced-midpoint bounded fallback theorem; TP2-2346F5D3E731ED56DB0A resumes the later composite-Franel escape frontier. Their distinct parent objectives and hard targets must remain referenceable rather than being erased by publication ordering.
